page: Microsoft Azure ND40rs_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server within the NDSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 40 dedicated Intel vCPUs paired with 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding 16.8 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes 2970 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage.

For accelerated workloads, the server is equipped with eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs, providing a total of 238 GB of VRAM. It also features RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) capabilities, which support low-latency, high-throughput inter-node communication in clustered environments.

Given the high density of GPUs, large memory capacity, and RDMA networking, this server represents a high-end hardware class designed for resource-intensive deployments. It is suited for workloads such as deep learning training, large-scale GPU-accelerated simulations, high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, and complex data science jobs.
